name: intel-devkit-install
description: Install or top up the Intel AI PC Developer Kit on Windows when the user asks to install the Dev Kit and approves the system change. Do not run intel-devkit-verify first. On Hermes, run as a standard user so Windows UAC can request Administrator, then poll until the installer job finishes. This setup does not install OpenVINO Model Server (OVMS). If the user asked only for the Dev Kit, stop when install passes. Continue only when their request includes a later step. Not for starting OVMS, downloading a chat model, switching Hermes to local inference, or the VS Code Continue coding assistant.
